title: Normalized native balanced tensor pullback
statement: Fix a prime l, a scheme X and an object U of its pro-etale site. For all native adic modules M,N, the explicitly constructed adicSliceNativeTensorIso identifies the balanced tensor of their native pullbacks with the pullback of their balanced tensor. Its composite after the native quotient is the monoidal inverse-image tensor map followed by the inverse image of the original quotient. The construction applies without freeness or flatness hypotheses.

theorem adicSliceNativeTensorIso_quotient {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime] {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (U : X.ProEt) (M N : AdicSheaf l X) :
    Mod.tensorπ ((adicUpperStar l U.hom).obj M) ((adicUpperStar l U.hom).obj N) ≫
        (adicSliceNativeTensorIso U M N).hom.hom =
      Functor.LaxMonoidal.μ (upperStar (WeilCoefficients.{u} l) U.hom) M.X N.X ≫
        (upperStar (WeilCoefficients.{u} l) U.hom).map (Mod.tensorπ M N)
